method.novelty_standard: Accept only a distinct source-stated rule, outcome branch, or consequential timing/exception interaction. Do not count changed arithmetic, names, cosmetic phrasing, or mechanical recombinations.

findings.title: Ordinary human Phase-2 turn order is not required by any question
findings.description: The rulebook expressly starts Phase 2 with the First Player, continues clockwise one turn at a time, and ends the phase after everyone has Revealed. The current questions test a legal individual Agent turn, early Reveal and skipping later turns, Combat Intrigue order, Round Start, Recall, and the special House Hagal insertion. None requires the order in which human Agent/Reveal turns alternate. Taking all of one human’s Agent turns consecutively before the next human acts changes access to contested spaces while preserving the answers currently required.
findings.why_not_covered: Q03 requires the effects of Revealing early but never asks who starts or how human turns alternate. Q04 limits one placement per individual Agent turn but does not specify who gets the next turn. Q10 specifies order only within Combat. Q21 asks Round Start and Recall, not Phase 2. Q18/Q59 specify when the Rival acts but not ordinary human order.

passages: Starting with the player who has the First Player marker and continuing clockwise, players take one turn at a time.
Once all players have taken a Reveal turn, this phase ends.

findings.title: Accepted Q52 ledger reference still mentions an excluded card
findings.description: The accepted Q52 entry still cites Guild Envoy although the current Q52 question/key correctly remove it and the ledger explicitly rejects it as Uprising-specific. This is stale provenance text, not an answer-key error or justification for another question.
findings.recommended_action: When updating the ledger for any accepted addition, remove Guild Envoy from the accepted Q52 reference; retain the rejection/history if desired.

proposed_questions.question: In a standard three- or four-player game, who takes the first turn in Phase 2, how do the players’ Agent and Reveal turns alternate, and when does that phase end?
proposed_questions.fixed_answer: The player with the First Player marker takes the first turn. Continue clockwise, one turn at a time; each player takes an Agent turn or a Reveal turn on their turn, rather than finishing all of their Agent turns before another player acts. Skip a player for the rest of the phase after that player’s Reveal turn. Phase 2 ends once every player has taken a Reveal turn, then proceed to Combat.
proposed_questions.novelty: Explicit alternating human turn procedure. First-player/clockwise/single-turn order is a distinct procedural rule with consequential placement priority, not new arithmetic or another instance of the ordinary occupancy rule. The skip-after-Reveal clause is already covered in Q03 and is included only to make the procedure complete; it is not counted as new coverage.
proposed_questions.alternative: Instead of adding a numbered question, amend Q03 to ask who starts Phase 2 and how human turns proceed, and amend its key to require First Player, clockwise, one turn at a time and all-Revealed phase completion.

answer_key_review.result: All 67 expected answers were compared with their relevant primary passages and applicable FAQ corrections. No material contradiction identified.
specific_challenges_resolved: Q13 checks the endgame at Recall after completing the round; reaching 10 during play does not stop the round. Its shorthand is terse but not a different trigger.
Q14 and Q53 shorthand about the VP threshold is clarified by the existing terminology_notes; the rule is 2 Influence awarding 1 VP.
Q20 second-place ties can pay the third reward in two-player play; FAQ Conflict says the reward rules differ only in four-player play. This is distinct from ordinary third place being unavailable.
Q21/Q39 correctly follow the FAQ for Sort Through the Chaos: take the Mentat at the start of the next round, superseding the older glossary wording.
Q25 correctly includes Research Station and The Great Flat as Combat spaces; direct PDF labels verified.
Q28 diagram rates 2/3/4/5 spice to 6/8/10/12 Solari were visually checked.
Q52 correctly omits Guild Envoy in the actual question/key despite the stale ledger reference.
Q58/Q59 correctly apply two-player spoiler rules and avoid solo-only Signet, resource/VP and Expert deployment procedures.

Q60–Q67 cover Foldspace acquisition eligibility, icon preservation, any-source deployment, draw reshuffling, initial setup, supply visibility, acquisition interleaving and the full non-Faction access map.
